canonical_data: OKF v0.2 Markdown and YAML knowledge bundle: index, log, concept files, and a bidirectional link graph with provenance and lifecycle metadata
strengths: OKF bundle costs zero tokens at baseline and is queried on demand
Microsecond local BM25 retrieval with no embedding API costs
Version-controlled plain text auditable with standard git diff and log
Provenance sources, generated-versus-verified trust tiers, and lifecycle metadata
Native MCP server over stdio plus skill and bootstrap scaffolding
weaknesses: Evidence is performance benchmarks only, with no task-accuracy evaluation
Single-language Go core with no Python or TypeScript SDK
Bundle conforms to the upstream OKF specification owned outside the repo
README names no operator or maintainer beyond a sponsor link
why_it_matters: A Git-native project memory that costs zero tokens at baseline and retrieves in microseconds, trading vector semantics for an open specification bundle that agents and humans read alike.
